This commit implements class inheritance parsing and adds comprehensive
testing for the E2003 diagnostic (superclass mismatch on reopening).

## Changes

### Parser Enhancement
- **Added class inheritance syntax**: `class Foo < Bar`
  - Parser now recognizes `<` operator after class name
  - Parses superclass identifier and stores in class_super_name
  - Validates superclass is an identifier
  - Gracefully handles missing superclass (syntax error)

**Implementation** (src/compiler/frontend/parser.cr:246-258):

  - Pass super_name_token to ExpressionNode creation

- **E2003 diagnostic test** (spec/semantic_cli_spec.cr:51-64)
  - Verifies error code and message format
  - Confirms secondary span showing previous declaration
  - Uses superclass_mismatch.cr fixture

- **Test fixture** (spec/semantic/test_data/superclass_mismatch.cr)
  - class Foo < Bar with one method
  - class Foo < Baz (reopening with different superclass)

- All 63 tests pass
- E2003 diagnostic correctly emitted by SymbolCollector

**Parser flow**:

- Now actually populated by parser

**Semantic analysis**:
- SymbolCollector.verify_superclass_consistency checks for conflicts
- Emits E2003 when reopening class with different superclass
- Preserves first superclass declaration in merged ClassSymbol
